about: I'm a full-stack developer with expertise in React.js, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL. I build responsive, scalable web applications and care about strong debugging, clean databases and thorough testing before anything ships.

Currently pursuing M.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at Chandigarh University (UID 25MCS10032), after graduating B.E. CSE from Sambhram Institute of Technology (VTU) with a CGPA of 8.7. I've interned at Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, where I developed and validated navigation-system software.
highlights: Software Engineering Intern at Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
M.E. CSE at Chandigarh University · B.E. CSE with CGPA 8.7
Full-stack builds in React.js, PHP & MySQL with end-to-end testing
Winner — Intra-College Science Exhibition · DevHacks 1.0 participant

faq.question: Are you available for a full-time role?
faq.answer: Yes — I'm pursuing M.E. CSE at Chandigarh University and I'm open to full-time roles and internships in full-stack development. The fastest way to reach me is the contact form, email or phone.

faq.question: What is your core tech stack?
faq.answer: React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap on the frontend; PHP and MySQL on the backend, with SQL, DBMS design and data validation. I also build Python/PyQt5 desktop tools and work with Java and C/C++.

faq.question: Do you have industry experience?
faq.answer: Yes — I completed a Software Engineering Internship at Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), where I developed navigation-system software, performed functional testing and validation, and prepared technical documentation for aerospace project delivery.

faq.question: What testing do you do?
faq.answer: Manual testing, functional testing and database testing with structured bug reporting. Every project I ship — including my Teachers Management System — goes through end-to-end functional and database validation.
